summary:
The salon upstairs works end to end on phone sizes, but the move is not finished: I found no hard-line break, no data loss and no crash, and five defects a player would notice, all around where the octopus and the player character stand and walk upstairs.

What works: on 360x740 and 320x568 (finger taps) the mirror opens, every bottle can be picked, both forced answers and the demo rule's "응, 해 볼래." stage completely, the log rows and the body colour are right, and reduced motion, the big button, a reload, a hidden tab and a second tab during the staging all end in a consistent state. The lift keeps the mirror and the octopus above the sheet on portrait phones and returns to exactly zero after every way of closing. Nothing is left on the attic wall. I could not reproduce "stuck at the top of the stairs".

The five defects (all "should"):
1. Taking the stairs while the octopus is mid-walk leaves it "walking" for good: its head stays lifted off its legs and it never wanders again on either floor until the next walk invitation.
2. Upstairs the octopus still wanders to the attic's idle spots, which upstairs land on the dye tub and mannequin, 12 cm in the air, or inside the sewing desk.
3. The octopus walks straight through the round stool on its normal way to the mirror, through the mannequin from one idle spot, and through or onto the player character.
4. If the player stands in front of the mirror when asking, the dye tub is put on top of them, the splash is hidden behind them, and afterwards they cannot walk out with the stick while the octopus stays on its mirror spot (the stair button still works).
5. The mirror button does nothing at all when the octopus is awake downstairs, which happens when its nap ends while the player is upstairs.

Suites, on a copy, with machine load 15 to 30: test-scene-perf gave 111 passed, 0 failed. SMOKE_ONLY=Y did not complete in two attempts (24 passed then a crash; 5 passed then a crash); both crashes were the script's own 5-second waits timing out on an open dialog, and no assertion failed. The perf test edits loosened one sanity floor and removed no check; the change is justified.

One thing about the evidence: screenshots taken with the repo's browser flags show a black box over the scene whenever the salon sheet is open in the pixel theme (also on production), so the smoke screenshots cannot show that the lift works. It is a capture artifact, not a game defect.

Everything is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-loft/ (notes.md, the t*.js scripts, the logs, shots/). The read-only tree is clean.

findings.title: Taking the stairs while the octopus is walking leaves it 'walking' for good: head lifted off its legs, no more wandering on either floor
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:3306 (octMountLoft cancels oct.walking without finishing it), js/scene3d.js:1945 (jumpTo, called by octUnmountLoft at :3313, does the same), js/app.js:1413-1423 (scheduleWander only runs when the app state is 'idle'). Screen: loft and attic.
findings.what: When the stair transition lands while the octopus is mid-walk (it wanders every 20 to 40 s), the scene drops the walk without resolving it. The app state stays 'walk' and the hop offset freezes (hop 0.416), so the head floats above the legs. It never wanders again upstairs, and after going back down it still does not (75 s watched; the control run wandered after 6 s). The screen-reader line keeps saying "문어는 걸어가는 중이야". A tap gives "응?" but does not unstick it; only a walk invitation resets it. Expected: it arrives upstairs idle, on the floor, and keeps wandering.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-loft && export NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) && node t2c-stuck.js 0.45,0.02 (starts a wander-style walk, presses #btn-stair when the octopus is 0.45 m from its target; 0.02 is the control). Natural, with no test call into the octopus: node t2-natural.js a (boot, finger tap on the stair button).
findings.evidence: t2c run: upstairs {st:'walk', hop:0.416}; back down {st:'walk', hop:0.416}, wandered=false in 75 s; control {st:'idle', hop:0}, wandered after 5.7 s. Natural run t2a.log: 'walk' with hop 0.416 for 100 s. Seen again in t1 and on the second climb in t6g.log. Picture: shots/t2c-compare.png (left stuck, second normal).
findings.suggested_fix: In octMountLoft and jumpTo, finish the walk instead of cancelling it (oct.walking.finish() resolves the promise and zeroes oct.hop), then place the octopus. As a belt, have the app set octState('idle') on the scene's 'octUp' event, which nothing listens to today.

findings.title: Upstairs the octopus wanders to the attic's idle spots: onto the dye tub and mannequin, floating 12 cm, into the sewing desk
findings.where: js/app.js:1097-1104 (allowedIdleAnchors) and :1413-1423 (scheduleWander) do not know about the loft; js/scene3d.js:1942-1949 (anchorPos / moveTo use attic coordinates inside the loft group); furniture at js/scene3d.js:3696 (dye tub), :3704 (mannequin). Screen: loft.
findings.what: While the octopus is upstairs the app keeps sending it to 'window', 'center', 'crate', and 'blanket' (lantern 4 or more) or 'board' (when posters exist). Upstairs these are: 'window' = (-1.80, 0.70), on top of the dye tub and against the mannequin; 'blanket' = (-0.65, 1.90) at y +0.116, hovering at the front edge with no blanket there; 'board' aims at (0.08, -1.70), inside the sewing desk; 'center' sits on the green cushion; 'crate' is beside the stair hole. Expected: upstairs it stays put or uses spots that are free upstairs.
findings.repro: node t1-wander.js (goes up, calls APP.walkTo for each anchor, the same call scheduleWander makes; prints positions and saves pictures). Natural: node t2e-wander-clock.js 4 (fake clock, no call into the octopus).
findings.evidence: t1 output: window -> [-1.798,-0.005,0.699]; blanket -> [-0.649,0.116,1.899]. Pictures shots/t1-loft-window.png (tub hidden under the octopus), shots/t1-loft-blanket.png. Natural: t2e-lv4.log shows it walking to 'center' at 14.5 s and 'crate' at 48 s; t3c.log line 1 shows it had wandered by itself to [-1.798,0.699]. The 'board' end point was not captured (the walk was still running when sampled).
findings.suggested_fix: Either skip wandering while scene.octUp() is true, or give the loft its own short list of free spots and map to it when the octopus is upstairs. Apply the blanket height only in the attic.

findings.title: Upstairs the octopus walks through furniture and through the player character
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:1950-1972 (walkPoint is a straight line), :2356-2358 (plAvoidOct returns unless PL.place === 'attic'), :2556 (the push-out is attic-only), :3709 (round stool at (-0.7,-0.5)). docs/SALON.md:951 promises the scene steps the player aside for the octopus.
findings.what: In the normal '바꾸기' staging the octopus goes from its arrival spot on the rug to the mirror in a straight line that passes through the round stool. From the 'window' idle spot it passes through the mannequin. If the player stands on the mirror spot or in the path, the octopus walks into them (centre distance 0.02 m and 0.04 m) and stands inside the player for about half a second before the player steps aside. Downstairs the player is moved out of the way first; upstairs neither that nor the push-out runs.
findings.repro: node t4c-ask-clock.js 360 740 dye none mount (stool); node t4c-ask-clock.js 360 740 dye anchor window (mannequin, then onto the player); node t4c-ask-clock.js 360 740 dye path crate.
findings.evidence: t4c.log: 'anchor window' dOP 0.02 from t=3.5 to 3.9; 'path crate' dOP 0.04 at t=3.5. Pictures shots/t4c-walk-stool.png (stool disappears inside the octopus) and shots/t4c-anchor-window.png (frames 07 to 10).
findings.suggested_fix: Let plAvoidOct and the push-out also run in the loft (octopus position plus the LSAL offset). Give the mirror walk one waypoint, or move the stool or the arrival spot so the straight line is clear.

findings.title: Asking while the player stands in front of the mirror: tub lands on the player, the splash is hidden, and the player cannot walk out afterwards
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:1640-1646 (salClearView sends the player to one fixed spot (0.35,-0.85), unreachable from in front of the mirror), :3731 (LROOM.boxes: sewing desk, sewing stool and round stool boxes touch, closing the floor in front of the mirror into a pocket), :2340-2349 (octopus and tub circles). Screen: loft, mirror corner.
findings.what: The natural place to stand when using the mirror is in front of it. From there, when the answer is '바꾸기', the tub is placed 0.16 m from the player. The player is walked only as far as (-0.61,-0.91) and stays between the camera and the tub, so the tub is hidden through pour and splash and the octopus is half covered. Afterwards the octopus stays on its mirror spot and the only way out, a gap between the mannequin and the round stool, is about 6 cm wide: 8 fixed stick directions and a rotating sweep never got out. The stair button still works (went down after 3.5 s), and the octopus wanders off after 20 to 40 s if L1 has not frozen it. Even with the octopus elsewhere, almost no straight stick direction leaves the pocket.
findings.repro: node t7c-clock.js (fake clock: player at (-0.95,-1.25), forced '바꾸기', then a stick sweep, then the stair button). node t3d-pinned.js PH (octopus held on the mirror spot, 8 directions plus a 12 s sweep).
findings.evidence: t7c.log: dTub 0.16 at 'tub', player ends [-0.606,-0.907], "player is still in the pocket", "stick sweep 8 s: NOT OUT", "stair button -> down true after 3.5 s". t3d.log: "fixed directions out 0/8 | sweep: NEVER OUT in 12 s". t3c.log (octopus elsewhere): 0/16 and 1/16 directions out. Picture shots/t7c-pocket.png.
findings.suggested_fix: Open the pocket: drop the collision box of the round stool or move it so the exit is wide. Make salClearView choose, from two or three candidate spots, the first one the route planner can reach.

findings.title: Mirror button is visible but does nothing when the octopus is awake downstairs
findings.where: js/app.js:813 (openSalon returns silently unless the octopus is upstairs; only the asleep case gets a toast), js/scene3d.js:2776-2777 (the button shows whenever the loft is visible). Screen: loft.
findings.what: If the octopus was asleep when the player went up, it does not follow, and a tap on the mirror correctly gives "지금은 아래층에서 자고 있어." with no wake and no log row. But when its nap ends while the player is still upstairs, it is awake downstairs, the mirror button is still there, and tapping it gives no sheet, no toast and no bubble. Going down and up again fixes it. Expected: a plain line, or no button.
findings.repro: node t6-noopen.js DEFG (real walk, sleep, go up, clock fast-forward 21 minutes, tap the mirror). node t6g-clock.js GF (forced: asleep, go up, APP.octState('idle'), tap twice).
findings.evidence: t6-DEFG.log: after 21 min {st:'idle', octUp:false, btnSalonHidden:false}; tap -> {sheet:false, toast:'', bubble:''}. t6g.log: two taps, same; "down and up again, tap mirror {octUp:true, sheet:true}".
findings.suggested_fix: Give this case its own factual line (for example "지금은 아래층에 있어."), or hide the button unless the octopus is upstairs or asleep, or let the octopus come up when it wakes while the player is upstairs (see L13).

findings.title: For '그대로' the player is not moved aside
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:1647-1651 (salClearView is called only from salonDye); js/app.js:1019 (keep branch).
findings.what: Commit 1f4ab08 moves the player out of the view only when the answer is '바꾸기'. With the player standing just in front of the octopus and the answer '그대로', the octopus was covered for the whole staging and the player did not move. For '바꾸기' from open floor the player ends at (0.33,-0.85), which is sensible; from in front of the mirror it is not (L4).
findings.repro: node t4c-ask-clock.js 360 740 keep front mount; compare node t4c-ask-clock.js 360 740 dye front mount.
findings.evidence: t4c.log: keep/front coverFrames 30/30, player stays [0.143,0.649]; dye/front coverFrames 29/72 (all before the walk), player ends [0.333,-0.852].
findings.suggested_fix: Run the same check at the moment the answer is shown, for both answers.

findings.title: Landscape phone: the octopus is under the sheet despite the lift
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:464 (lift is capped so the mirror top stays below the top bar). Screen: 740x360.
findings.what: At 740x360 the 246 px sheet leaves 114 px of scene. The lift stops at 0.667 m to keep the mirror top visible, and the octopus is fully under the sheet in all six spots (legs 34 to 111 px under; the head too except on the mirror spot). With a taller sheet the bottle shelf goes under as well. Portrait sizes are fine.
findings.evidence: t5-740.log: "OCT UNDER SHEET by 80px", 96, 56, 89, 26. t5f.log, 740x360 block. Picture shots/t5-open-sizes.png (third panel).
findings.suggested_fix: Accept it (the game is portrait), or in short viewports prefer the octopus over the mirror top when both cannot fit.

findings.title: Furniture mode can be carried upstairs, where it is a dead panel
findings.where: js/app.js:3696-3722 (furnOpen / furnUI); the stair button is not hidden in furniture mode. Screen: loft.
findings.what: With furniture mode on, the stair button still works. Upstairs the panel stays ("가구를 골라", sofa and crate tiles), the tiles do nothing, and the mirror button and the big button are hidden until the player presses done. I did not check whether production behaves the same.
findings.evidence: Run output (recorded in notes.md): went up in furn mode {furnOn:true, furnUI:true, btnSalonHidden:true, octUp:true, goHidden:'hidden/block', tiles:2}; tile click upstairs {carried:null, title:'가구를 골라'}.
findings.suggested_fix: Leave furniture mode when leaving the attic, or hide the stair button while it is on.

findings.title: Screen-reader scene line gives wrong places after the move
findings.where: js/app.js:1113-1116 (SPOT_DESC / sceneDescText use the app's anchor name); docs/SALON.md:954 already notes the loft reads the attic text.
findings.what: After a '바꾸기' upstairs and going back down, the line reads "문어는 거울 옆에서 쉬고 있어." while the octopus stands in the middle of the attic, where there is no mirror (the app anchor stays 'salon'). Upstairs with the octopus it names attic spots such as "창가" and "나무 상자 옆".
findings.repro: node t7c-clock.js (last line); node t7-down.js A.
findings.evidence: t7c.log: after going down, oct [-0.005,0.001,0.204], appAnchor 'salon', desc "등불 2칸 켜진 다락, 비 오는 낮. 문어는 거울 옆에서 쉬고 있어. 몸은 파란색이야."
findings.suggested_fix: Reset the app anchor to the scene's when the octopus is put back in the attic, and say it is upstairs while octUp is true.

findings.title: Docs still describe the old place and two things that are no longer true
findings.where: docs/SALON.md:126 (section 2 places the mirror in the attic), :773 (says the mirror button hides in the loft), :951 (says the scene steps the player aside for the octopus); docs/ROOM_EXPANSION.md:625 and :627.
findings.what: SALON.md was not updated for the move. The 11-11 memo in ROOM_EXPANSION.md says smoke Y is not registered and must be rewritten (it is registered and rewritten), and that there is no mirror button while the octopus sleeps (there is one, with a toast).
findings.evidence: File lines as cited, compared with the behaviour in t6-DEFG.log and the smoke Y source.
findings.suggested_fix: Update SALON.md sections 2 and 14 and the memo once L2 to L5 are decided.

findings.title: Screenshots taken with the repo's browser flags show a black box over the scene while the salon sheet is open (pixel theme)
findings.where: tools/smoke.js:1484 and the other tools launching with --use-gl=swiftshader; picture salon-sheet-320x568-pixel.png written by smoke Y.
findings.what: With the repo's launch flags, a page screenshot with the salon sheet open in the pixel theme has a black block over the top of the scene, hiding the mirror. The canvas itself is correct (canvas.toDataURL), the system theme is fine, and the same page launched with --use-angle=swiftshader is fine. It also happens on production 1e1c18f, so it is not from this branch and is a capture artifact, not a game defect. But the smoke's own screenshot cannot show that the lift keeps the mirror visible.
findings.repro: node t5d-prod.js 320 568 with TREE pointing at an export of 1e1c18f, and with UP=1 on the final tree; node t5e-modes.js (five launch modes); node t5b-black.js (page versus canvas).
findings.evidence: shots/t5d.png (production and final both black), shots/t5e.png (only the angle panel shows the room), shots/t5b-320-open-canvas.png versus shots/t5b-320-open-page.png, shots/smoke-sheets.png (the smoke's own picture).
findings.suggested_fix: Take evidence screenshots with --use-angle=swiftshader, or assert on canvas pixels. Check once on a real phone that the scene is drawn behind the open sheet.

findings.title: The octopus's arrival spot upstairs is on top of the green floor cushion
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:3307 (arrival spot (-0.3, 0.2)); the cushion is at (-0.4, 0.3).
findings.what: On arrival the octopus stands on the green cushion, which disappears under it; the 'center' idle spot does the same.
findings.evidence: shots/t1-loft-arrive.png; t2e-lv4.log "stops at center ... OVERLAPS cushion B by 0.18 m".
findings.suggested_fix: Move the arrival spot or the cushion by about 0.4 m.

findings.title: Decide what the octopus does upstairs and what the mirror says when it is downstairs
findings.where: Design: js/app.js scheduleWander and openSalon; js/scene3d.js octMountLoft.
findings.what: Two decisions sit behind L2 and L5. (a) Upstairs, should the octopus stay where it arrived (cheapest, nothing to place) or have its own two or three loft spots (livelier, needs spots clear of furniture and the stair landing)? (b) When it is awake downstairs and the player taps the mirror: show a plain line (cheapest); hide the button (nothing to explain, but the mirror looks dead); or have it come up by itself when it wakes (nicest, but it then moves floors without the player doing anything, which should be weighed against the 'never steer the octopus' line).

findings.title: Smoke scenario Y did not complete on this machine: its 5-second waits time out under load
findings.what: Two runs on a copy, both ended in "CRASH in Y: page.waitForSelector: Timeout 5000ms exceeded" while the log says the dialog was resolved as open and visible: at :2552 after 24 passes, and at :2413 after 5 passes. No assertion failed in either run. Machine load average was 16 and 30; I believe this is load only, but I could not get a clean run to prove it. The author reports 58 passed.
findings.repro: On a copy of the tree: export NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) && SMOKE_ONLY=Y node tools/smoke.js
findings.evidence: smoke-Y.log (24 passed, 1 failed), smoke-Y2.log (5 passed, 1 failed).
findings.suggested_fix: Rerun Y on an idle machine before merging; give those waits the 30 s the other helpers already use.
